values.d:fix_short: before the DINO loader fix, so the DINO half is random
values.d:fix_status: The numbers in this version of the report were computed BEFORE that fix: the DINO half of every cached embedding was effectively random, so the results below are close to BioCLIP 2 features alone. The fix and a full re-run (cards L2-f, L3-d, L6-d) were in progress when this version was built; rebuilding this report after them refreshes every number and table.
values.d:knn_note: The kNN scorer is the weakest here, consistent with the broken DINO half described in Section 3.11: kNN is the only scorer that cannot learn to ignore part of the vector.
values.d:sets_note: but they are almost always a single species. This is not a success of the sets; it is a property of the threshold rule when the model is already more than 90% accurate (Section 7)
values.d:selective_note: below the target: the post-cutoff test photos are harder than the pre-cutoff calibration photos, so a threshold tuned on calibration is too permissive on test
values.d:reach_yes_vl: 3-photo top-1, single-photo top-5, 3-photo top-5, family top-1 (1 photo), backoff accuracy at reported rank (1 photo)
values.d:reach_no_vl: single-photo top-1, genus top-1 (1 photo), selective accuracy (answered photos)
values.d:reach_yes_in: single-photo top-1, 3-photo top-1, single-photo top-5, 3-photo top-5, genus top-1 (1 photo), family top-1 (1 photo), backoff accuracy at reported rank (1 photo), selective accuracy (answered photos)
values.d:e2e_note: 95.0% of the answers were flagged "not in catalogue". Before the DINO fix, live and cached DINO vectors disagree, so every live photo looks far from the gallery; this is the clearest symptom of the bug in Section 3.11 and the first number to recheck after the fix.
values.d:dino_benefit: and the system has not yet been shown to benefit from a second encoder
